title: looptnr-c1-spectroscopy: transfer-matrix spectra, run scripts, and analysis for loop tensor network renormalization on the c=1 critical line of the six-vertex model
description: Transfer-matrix spectra of all loop tensor network renormalization (LoopTNR) runs on the c=1 critical line of the six-vertex model used in two companion papers, together with the run scripts, the Julia environment, and the analysis scripts that produce the figures, tables, and quoted numbers. Code: MIT License. Data: CC BY 4.0.
